title: Hive project file, your own (hive.local.toml)
description: Your own values and preferences, layered over hive.toml. Git should ignore it.

toolchain.description: where panes start: inside a Nix dev shell, a devcontainer, mise's or direnv's environment, or none (auto: whichever the directory has)

vars.description: values for [env] names, and your own settings

secrets.description: variables read from your secret store when panes start, by reference

additionalProperties.description: a reference to your secret store: keychain:<service>[/<account>], secret-service:<attr>=<value>[,…], pass:<path>, op://<vault>/<item>/<field>

kind.description: an agent kind (hive agent manifests), or a list in order of preference

start.description: false: never start this agent here
